newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light soymeal trade in afternoo.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light soymeal trade in afternoo.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw only light trade in South American soymeal pellets despite a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening on the back of bullish USDA supply/demand figures issued this afternoon, market sources said.
"We saw a couple of nearby trades at firmer levels but with a strong dollar most buyers were not prepared to pay the around $3 seller protection ahead of the USDA figures," a broker said.
Afloat and Jan shipment Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $310 a tonne cif Rotterdam, up $4.5 from yesterday. March without extension changed hands at $282 a tonne cif.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets also traded $4.5 up at $289 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Otherwise the strong dollar kept a lid on dollar priced material. A few trades were reported in mark-priced goods.
March EU rapmeal changed hands at 29.90 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine, April at 29.35, Aug/Oct up 0.35 at 24.35 and Nov/Jan at 25.75 fob.
April EU sunmeal pellets fetched 20.50 marks fob Spijk.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
